g.text: Independent engine trials at 100 to 1,000 particles/s
Each PR was applied alone to the same upstream revision. Green means less elapsed time.
Five interleaved timed runs after one warmup per variant and condition; fixed seeds, one worker.
Median whole-process times include initialization and output. All concentration payloads matched.
